players.product: VHM custom DRAM 3D-stacked onto the SoC via wafer-on-wafer (WoW), plus S-SiCap stacked silicon capacitors and silicon-capacitor interposers for AI/HPC advanced packages

quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 consolidated results: net revenue NT$2,362,877 thousand (US$74,617 thousand), up 13% QoQ and 78% YoY; gross margin 49% (46% in 1Q26, 42% in 2Q25); operating income NT$725,672 thousand, 31% operating margin; net income attributable to shareholders of the parent NT$681,172 thousand; basic EPS NT$4.18 (NT$4.15 in 1Q26).
quarterly_data.figure: revenue NT$2,362,877 thousand (+13% QoQ, +78% YoY); gross margin 49%; operating margin 31%; EPS NT$4.18

quarterly_data.signal: Quarterly revenue by product line (NT$M, chart values): 2Q26 IoTRAM 1,688 (1,474 in 1Q26), S-SiCap 638 (572 in 1Q26, 558 in 4Q25, 66 in 1Q25), VHM 37 (54 in 1Q26).
quarterly_data.figure: 2Q26: IoTRAM NT$1,688M; S-SiCap NT$638M; VHM NT$37M

quarterly_data.signal: IoTRAM product line update: very strong market demand and IoTRAM adoption - standard DRAM pricing continues to push customers to IoTRAM, with higher volume and higher pricing; ApSRAM mass production continues, wearables leading and global MCU vendors widely adopting ApSRAM. Long term, the company says IoTRAM's market position is stronger but moderated by capacity limitation: conversion from standard DRAM to IoTRAM is generally sticky, market demand exceeds current manufacturing capacity, and AP Memory continues to seek more capacity resources.

S-SiCap in advanced packaging: IPC (capacitors embedded in the silicon interposer, up to 4 reticles) began mass production in 2025 and the ramp continues; IPD in substrate (capacitors embedded in the package substrate, for all varieties of 2.5D/3D HPC packages) started mass production in 2Q'26 with a rapid ramp-up expected in 1H27; landside capacitors (LSC/IPD, mainly mobile) started mass production in 2Q'26.
quarterly_data.figure: IPD in substrate MP started 2Q'26, rapid ramp expected 1H27; IPC MP since 2025

quarterly_data.signal: Future outlook (company): strong business growth - IoTRAM and S-SiCap product lines are growing rapidly, and IPD in particular is entering an unprecedented rapid mass-production ramp in support of a new embedded-in-substrate application for AI/HPC; VHM is expected to enter mass production in 2028 (the adoption timeline shows 1+8Hi VHMStack functional silicon demonstrated and multiple AI accelerators with VHM in design). The company is securing capacity for 2027 and beyond through deposits (customer advance payments) for wafer supply and OSAT capacity.
